The '''Great Grass Plains''', an area of green grass and rolling hills,<ref name="BFI guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> were located south of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TPMN">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' (novel)]]</ref> [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]] was at one end of the Plains.<ref name="SW:CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Shaak Ridge/Legends|Shaak Ridge]] was a hill on the Plains which overlooked a valley.<ref name="GB" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] fought against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of the Great Grass Plains]].<ref name="SWE1" /> The main part of the engagement took place on the Plains 40 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from Theed.<ref name="SW:CL" /> At the time of the battle, a redoubt was on the Great Grass Plains, along with ruins.<ref name="BFI guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Great Grass Plains first appeared with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and its tie-ins. In the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] expansion pack ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]'', the Great Grass Plains was mentioned in the DataBank entry for the Gungan civilization. The Battle on the Plains took place here.
